narratives.Description: Wire OpenClaw into greptile poller template, agent preamble, and heartbeat contract for copy-paste correct pollers. Templates must name OpenClaw completion channels; heartbeat may map to .deft-scratch subagent-status or document OpenClaw-native liveness.
narratives.Overview: Epic #2874 P1. Depends on #2875 primitive names ideally; can land with documented sessions_spawn names if matrix not yet merged.
narratives.UserStory: As an OpenClaw review-monitor author, I want poller and preamble templates that name sessions_spawn and heartbeat, so that monitors are copy-paste correct.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Update content/templates/swarm-greptile-poller-prompt.md for OpenClaw sessions_spawn + completion channel. Step 2: Update content/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md backends list. Step 3: Update docs/subagent-heartbeat.md with OpenClaw mapping. Step 4: CHANGELOG #2879. Verification: templates name OpenClaw; task check:merge. Touch concrete source files listed in plan.metadata.swarm.file_scope. Verification evidence: run targeted unit tests or verify gates and capture pass evidence in the PR.
narratives.Traces: Acceptance criteria map to #2879; missing_traces_justification until implementation maps lines.

items.title: Poller template works for OpenClaw spawn

narrative.Acceptance: Given templates/swarm-greptile-poller-prompt.md, when used on OpenClaw, then sessions_spawn and completion channel are named (not only Warp/grok-build).

items.title: Preamble lists OpenClaw as first-class backend

narrative.Acceptance: Given templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md provider-neutral backends, when read, then OpenClaw is listed.
Given docs/subagent-heartbeat.md or equivalent pointer, when OpenClaw review-monitor runs, then liveness contract is documented (file heartbeat or OpenClaw-native alternate).
